description: This file manages locale configurations for the Moment.js library, including loading, defining, updating, and retrieving locale data, as well as handling global locale settings.

classes.name: Locale
classes.description: Class representing locale-specific configurations for date and time formatting.

methods.name: normalizeLocale
methods.description: Normalizes locale keys by converting to lowercase and replacing underscores with hyphens.

methods.name: chooseLocale
methods.description: Selects the most appropriate locale from a list of locale names.

methods.name: loadLocale
methods.description: Loads a locale by name, attempting to require the locale module if not already loaded.

methods.name: getSetGlobalLocale
methods.description: Gets or sets the global locale based on a key and optional values.

methods.name: defineLocale
methods.description: Defines a new locale or overrides an existing one with provided configuration.

methods.name: updateLocale
methods.description: Updates an existing locale with new configuration data.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Retrieves locale data for a given key or locale object.

methods.name: listLocales
methods.description: Returns a list of all available locale keys.
